Yes. That is how the program works: you: Yes. That is how the program works: you choose the products, set your own prices and bring the orders. The store keeps the stock and packs the parcel; unless you choose your own courier, the store delivers it too.
Can I list your products on my Facebook: Can I list your products on my Facebook page and website with photos, details and prices?
Yes. The portal shows every product with: Yes. The portal shows every product with its photos, details, the suggested price and your cost. You can download the product photos for your posts, share a product or your whole store on WhatsApp and Facebook, and set your own selling price, which can be your cost or any price above it. Every approved reseller also gets an online store that shows only the products they picked, at their prices.

You do not send it to us; you enter the: You do not send it to us; you enter the order yourself in the portal: the customer's name, phone and address, the products and quantities, and your selling price for each. The form shows your customer's bill and your profit before you save. The order then reaches the store, which confirms it, packs it and delivers it.
How is the parcel sent, and who collects: How is the parcel sent, and who collects the money?
What is deducted from the money collecte: What is deducted from the money collected, and how much is my profit?
Your profit is your selling price minus: Your profit is your selling price minus your cost, for every piece. Your cost is the price shown on each product in the portal; that is what the store keeps for the product. The delivery charge and VAT are added to your customer's bill on top, so they are not taken out of your profit, and there is no separate packaging charge on orders the store delivers.

Your profit waits while the order is on: Your profit waits while the order is on its way and becomes payable once the order is delivered. Open :withdrawals in the portal and request any amount up to your available balance, to bKash, Nagad, Rocket or a bank account. The store reviews the request and pays it, and you see its status in the portal. The :earnings page lists every order with its sale amount, your cost, your profit and its status.
